about: Where India's inward remittances come from and where they arrive, from the Reserve Bank of India's remittances surveys of banks (not on DBIE): shares in per cent, by source country and by destination state, for 2016-17, 2020-21 and 2023-24. Copied on 13-10-2026 from the RBI Bulletin article of 19-03-2025, 'Changing Dynamics of India's Remittances: Insights from the Sixth Round of India's Remittances Survey'. null is the article's '–' (not reported for that round). For 2023-24 the shares cover transfers for family maintenance and savings and local withdrawals from non-resident deposit accounts.
source_title: RBI Bulletin, 19-03-2025: Changing Dynamics of India's Remittances: Insights from the Sixth Round of India's Remittances Survey
